catboyAgentEnrolmentId OBJECT-TYPE
    SYNTAX      DisplayString (SIZE (0..20))
    MAX-ACCESS  read-only
    STATUS      current
    DESCRIPTION "The catboy-agent enrolment id (agent_id issued by the control
                 plane at enrolment), as decimal digits. The control plane joins
                 an SNMP-discovered host to its configuration item on this value;
                 sysObjectID only says the host is a fleet host. Zero-length
                 while the host is not enrolled."
    ::= { catboyAgentObjects 1 }

catboyAgentLastHeartbeat OBJECT-TYPE
    SYNTAX      DateAndTime
    MAX-ACCESS  read-only
    STATUS      current
    DESCRIPTION "Time of the last successful heartbeat to the control plane,
                 which is also the last successful CatCMDB sync. All eight
                 octets are zero if no heartbeat has succeeded since the agent
                 started."
    ::= { catboyAgentObjects 4 }

catboyAgentTrustAnchor OBJECT-TYPE
    SYNTAX      DisplayString (SIZE (0|64))
    MAX-ACCESS  read-only
    STATUS      current
    DESCRIPTION "SHA-256 fingerprint (lowercase hex) of the root CA installed as

catboyAgentDiskFull OBJECT-TYPE
    SYNTAX      TruthValue
    MAX-ACCESS  read-only
    STATUS      current
    DESCRIPTION "true(1) while any local filesystem the agent watches is above
                 the agent's disk-full threshold, false(2) otherwise. A change
                 of value sends catboyAgentDiskFullNotification."
    ::= { catboyAgentObjects 7 }

catboyAgentBackupFailed OBJECT-TYPE
    SYNTAX      TruthValue
    MAX-ACCESS  read-only
    STATUS      current
    DESCRIPTION "true(1) while the most recent backup of this host failed or is
                 overdue, false(2) otherwise. A change of value sends
                 catboyAgentBackupFailedNotification."
    ::= { catboyAgentObjects 8 }

    SYNTAX      Unsigned32 (1..2147483647)
    MAX-ACCESS  not-accessible
    STATUS      current
    DESCRIPTION "Row index. Stable for a given service name while the agent
